input.summary: Remove the three-year USD 2,000,000 take-or-pay commitment; Fees payable only for Services ordered or used
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a multi-year take-or-pay commitment with no reduction or termination right, so we have replaced Section 2.1 with a non-binding forecast: we pay for Services we order or use. This also removes the conflict with Sections 7.1 and 12.3, which already state that no minimum-use charge or minimum-volume commitment applies. If a commitment is commercially essential, we could consider one limited to the current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice, with a true-up rather than a penalty.

ops.oldText: 2.1 Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: 2.1 Customer has no minimum purchase, volume, or take-or-pay commitment under this Agreement. Any volume or spend figures the Parties exchange are non-binding forecasts, and Customer is obligated to pay only the Fees for Services actually ordered under an Order Form or actually used.
